_readme: Source of truth for /placements/. Add one object per closed hire. Never include candidate names. Set company only when the client has agreed to be named. Run python3 build/build.py after editing. Fields: role, stage, city, closed (e.g. 'Sep 2026'), time (e.g. 'Offer in 21 days'), summary, company (optional).
